It includes a mask that conceals the horse's head.|Inventory|TotK}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== The Monster Bridle is a type of [[Bridle]] that can be purchased at the [[Fang and Bone]] for 399 [[Mon]].{{Cite|Ah, a classic. The {{Color BotW|Blue|Monster Bridle}} will cost you {{Color BotW|Red|399 mon}}. Is that OK?|Kilton|BotW}} These Bridles were handmade by the shop's proprietor, [[Kilton]], though he had a more monstrous [[Horse]] in mind when he made them. The Monster Bridle is a piece of [[Monster Horse Gear]], which is a set of [[Horse Gear]].{{Cite Book|quote= |book= CaC |publisher= |page= 161}} It can be equipped onto Horses at either the [[Highland Stable]], [[Outskirt Stable]], [[South Akkala Stable]], or [[Woodland Stable]].{{Cite|Change to {{Color BotW|Red|Monster Bridle}}?|Canni|BotW}} Like other Bridles, Monster Bridles are unable to be worn by [[Epona]] or the [[Giant Horse]].{{Cite|Hello there! That's a mighty find horse you have. If you like, I can change out her {{Color BotW|Blue|gear}} or maybe... Oh? Actually, this horse is different from any I've ever seen before. My, she's so lovely and graceful... I'm sorry, but I'm pretty sure this little lady would absolutely hate it if you changed her mane or gear. I'm so sorry about that.|Canni|BotW}}{{Cite|Hello there! That's a mighty find horse you have. If you like, I can change out its {{Color BotW|Blue|gear}} or maybe... Oh? My goodness, that's no pony, is it? It's so big! I'm sorry, but I don't think I have any {{Color BotW|Blue|gear}} that'd fit such a large horse, and I bet it wouldn't like its {{Color BotW|Blue|mane}} handled...
